summary.text: AmyRose Murphy is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Angelito Tenorio (D).

A former American Sign Language interpreter and small-business owner who lives in West Allis, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she supports a modified zero-based budgeting approach for the state.

paragraphs.text: Murphy said in a Ballotpedia survey that she was born in Milwaukee, raised in Madison and attended the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee Interpreter Training Program.

She described herself as a former American Sign Language interpreter, owner of an interpreting and consulting agency, former small-business owner and community volunteer, and said she serves on her neighborhood association and the KODA Midwest Executive Board.
Murphy said she is a Master Herbalist, has four children and one grandchild, and lives in West Allis.

Murphy's three campaign messages in the survey were responsible state budgeting, including a modified zero-based budgeting approach in which programs are regularly evaluated for purpose, effectiveness and cost; protecting Wisconsin families and children; and protecting individual freedoms.
